description: Finite stages, finite cardinalities, and the power-set recurrence.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.CumulativeHierarchy.finite_stages.{u} :
  ZFSet.vonNeumann 0 = ∅ ∧
    ZFSet.vonNeumann 1 = {∅} ∧
      ZFSet.vonNeumann 2 = {∅, {∅}} ∧
        ZFSet.vonNeumann 3 = {∅, {∅}, {{∅}}, {∅, {∅}}} ∧
          (∀ (n : ℕ), Finite ↥(ZFSet.vonNeumann ↑n)) ∧
            (∀ (n : ℕ), (ZFSet.vonNeumann ↑(n + 1)).card = 2 ^ (ZFSet.vonNeumann ↑n).card) ∧
              (ZFSet.vonNeumann 4).card = 16 ∧ (ZFSet.vonNeumann 5).card = 65536
